Maya R: quick sync — wrapping up RCA for INC-2026. I have 4 outstanding actions that need owners/ETAs so we can close the playbook. Can people call out ownership inline?
Jordan P: I'll take ACTION-1 — add fallback routing + update runbook. ETA Mon 2026-04-06. Will post PR link when ready.
Priya S: ACTION-2 (verify quantized model rollout + regressions). Owner: Priya. ETA Wed 2026-04-08. Need a small test pool from eng-platform to validate perf.
Sam O: Oncall will handle ACTION-3 (tighten canary thresholds + monitoring alert). I'll schedule canary tomorrow. ETA 2026-04-05. @Maya leave the runbook step for us to validate.
Diego M: Product will handle ACTION-4 (customer comms draft + affected list). ETA Fri 2026-04-09. Need a list of impacted accounts from support.
Nikhil K: I can support infra testing for ACTION-2 (Priya) — can run the perf jobs Tue morning.
Jordan P: dependency note: eng-platform to create test pool ticket (#54321) for Priya. I'll kick that off after this thread.
Maya R: thanks — below is the current open-items snippet I'm tracking. Please copy/paste to confirm if ETA/owner OK:
```
- ACTION-1: fallback routing + runbook — owner: Jordan P — ETA: 2026-04-06
- ACTION-2: quant rollout verification — owner: Priya S (infra: Nikhil K) — ETA: 2026-04-08
- ACTION-3: canary thresholds + alert tuning — owner: Sam O — ETA: 2026-04-05
- ACTION-4: customer comms + list — owner: Diego M — ETA: 2026-04-09
```
Priya S: confirmed — owner OK. I've opened draft perf tests and linked them in the RCA doc. PR will be up today.
Sam O: done — scheduled canary for 2026-04-05 09:00 PT, added steps to runbook. :white_check_mark:
Jordan P: created ticket #54321 and added test pool details, assigned to eng-platform oncall. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/54321
Diego M: noted; @support can you attach the affected accounts export to the RCA doc? I'll produce comms once I have it.
Nikhil K: I'll run infra tests Tue and paste results in the thread.
Maya R: perfect. If nothing changes I'll roll these into the closure checklist EOD. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your item so I can mark closed.
incident-bot: Reminder: actions unclosed 72h before SLA will escalate to eng-leads. See policy: https://redwood.example/policies/action-escalation
Maya R: last ask — if any of these ETAs slip, post an update in this thread so I can adjust the closure timeline. Thanks all.
Jordan P: acknowledged :thumbsup:
Priya S: :white_check_mark: (will update if blocked by infra)
Sam O: :white_check_mark:
Diego M: :white_check_mark: (waiting on support attachment)
Nikhil K: will post results Tue morning.
Maya R: closing note: I'll file the closure checklist once the 4 items have a :white_check_mark:. If any cross-team handoff needed, I'll ping the relevant lead.
